newsitem.title: INDIA: INDIAN HEADLINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Dec 24.
newsitem.headline: INDIAN HEADLINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Dec 24.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors affecting Indian stock markets on Tuesday morning:

** Market regulator, the Securities & Exchange Board of India's (SEBI) proposal to allow 100 percent book building in equity issues has been put on hold after being opposed by its governing board, the Economic Times reports.
The issue was discussed at a recent SEBI meeting but was put on the back burner on the ground that this would inhibit the right of investors to apply for an issue, the paper says.
** Finance Minister P. Chidambaram said apprehensions about an economic recession, being talked of by the industry, were highly misplaced, the Observer says.

The minister said though low credit offtake, sluggish capital market and other indicators might show an economic slowdown, the fundamentals of the Indian economy continued to be strong, the paper reports.
** State-run Bank of Baroda has cut its prime lending rate (PLR) by 50 basis points to 14.5 percent, the Business Standard reports. The PLR cut will take effect from January 1, 1997.
The bank has also narrowed its interest rate spread to three percentage points from 3.5, a move likely to spark a fresh round of interest rate cuts, the paper says.
** Issuers are expected to place over 20 billion rupees worth of debt in January 1997 even as the private placement market continues to throb with activity, the Economic Times says.
** The Indian rupee opened at 35.825/835 per dollar, little changed from Monday's close of 35.82/83. Trading range for the rupee is seen between 35.80 and 35.83 per dollar, dealers said.
** Profit-taking in blue-chip stocks inflicted small losses in Indian shares on Monday, with the Bombay Stock Exchange and most other bourses closed for Christmas vacations on Wednesday.
The 30-share index of the Bombay Stock Exchange .BSESN lost 17.15 points, or 0.55 percent, to end at 3,093.04.
** The 50-stock National Stock Exchange index .NSEI fell 2.4 points to close at 882.0.
** The Delhi share index .DE eased 5.01 points to 673.77.
** The Calcutta index dropped 1.33 points to 405.18.
